headline: Pension Increases from January 1, 2027. New Scenarios Emerge for Seniors
summary: Greek pension increases from January 1, 2027 depend on the indexation formula and political and budgetary developments. Options under discussion were outlined, alongside S&P's October 2 assessment.
why: Pension indexation shapes government spending and household income in Greece, which affects public finances and sovereign creditworthiness watched by investors.
